protects_against: Retained WAV mutation or decoded-content mismatch
Duplicate parent content or splitting matched variants into independent performers
Unknown voice authenticity incorrectly converted to real voice
Transfer receipts claiming a successful full-body response as a byte range

negative_network_checks.ignored_range: Injected status-200 response into the opener; fetch raised DataIntegrityError and response.read.assert_not_called() passed.
negative_network_checks.redirect: Called DirectResponseOnly.http_error_302 with a BytesIO redirect body and Location header; handler declined with None and body.tell() remained zero.
negative_network_checks.initial_check_correction: The first test incorrectly expected HTTPError directly from the redirect handler. urllib's opener owns that final error; the corrected check verifies declined redirect and unread body.

independent_review.finding: urllib default redirect handler may consume an unmetered redirect body.
independent_review.fix: DirectResponseOnly disables automatic redirect following before body consumption.

scope: No GPU execution, model training, model evaluation, official score, or independent audio listening.
